//: Config-as-code for the RENDERER service only (set Settings → Config-as-code → Railway config file = apps/renderer/railway.json). The API keeps the root railway.json. Private networking only: never generate a public domain for this service. See apps/renderer/README.md.

build.//watchPatterns: Redeploy only when the renderer or the lockfile it installs from changes — an API or web push must not rebuild it.

deploy.//healthcheckPath: /health answers 503 until Chromium has actually launched (and whenever it cannot), so a build whose browser cannot start never takes traffic.
